day_shape: 88 items: State Dept sanctions Iranian shadow-fleet flag registries and a Türkiye-based aviation firm, heavy Khamenei 13 Aban cycle citing 'end of American invincibility', IRGC claims 15th MQ-1 downed over Qeshm, IDF strike kills Amal paramedic in Qabrikha.

threads.label: US sanctions on Iran shadow fleet
threads.summary: The State Department announced designations targeting a criminal network selling fraudulent ship-registry flags to Iran's shadow fleet, alongside a Türkiye-based company providing ground services to sanctioned Iranian airlines. Treasury's OFAC acted in parallel, per spokesman Tommy Pigott's November 4 statement.

threads.label: 13 Aban Khamenei messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a series of statements marking the National Day of Struggle Against Global Arrogance, declaring the 'end of the myth of American invincibility' and urging continuation of the 'ever-stronger Iran' strategy. IRIB and Defa Press amplified with coverage of Tehran rallies, Trump-effigy burnings in Revolution Square and student mobilisations.

threads.label: Regime framing of US midterms
threads.summary: Iranian state outlets and officials seized on Republican midterm losses, with IRIB citing Vance blaming the 'war with Iran' for the defeat and Larijani and Rezaei claiming a 'strategic defeat' for Trump. Jerusalem Post and Iran International carried parallel Vance quotes and analyses of how the result may shape Trump's Iran policy.

threads.label: IRGC drone-interception claims over Qeshm
threads.summary: Defa Press and the IRGC said a 15th US MQ-1 drone was intercepted and destroyed over Qeshm Island airspace, with IRGC spokesman quipping 'MQ-9 to MQ-Gone' and claiming 56 MQ-9s destroyed overall. Quds Force commander Qaani said the resistance front is 'united across theatres'.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said a drone strike in Qabrikha, southern Lebanon, killed two suspects observing troops; Lebanon's health ministry identified the slain man as an Amal-linked paramedic, the first such strike in weeks. Separately the IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Hamas military-intelligence operations chief Jamal Abu Saeed and six other operatives, with Chief of Staff Zamir vowing to block Hezbollah reconstitution.

threads.label: Oct 7 IDF probe findings
threads.summary: Israeli reporting on newly disclosed IDF probes said the air-force chief spent hours exploring a strike on Hamas commander Mohammed Deif before October 7, after top Hamas figures were identified moving into tunnels on the night of October 6–7. Times of Israel said the movement was among at least five warning signs commanders underestimated.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported a Tehran Revolutionary Court sentenced social-media activist Amirhossein Mousavi to death for 'corruption on earth' over X posts, per his lawyer. Norway-based Iran Human Rights said at least 77 people were executed in October, bringing 2026's total to 691 including 36 protesters.
